blocks.note: Current model shows a modest bias toward LEFT (negative intercept) and a moderate sensitivity to stimulus magnitude (b≈1.5). To accelerate learning of the RIGHT decision boundary, increase the proportion of RIGHT‑correct items and add a moderate bonus for RIGHT responses. This should improve discrimination and raise overall accuracy toward the certification threshold.

After the high‑bonus, right‑biased block the learner shows a strong sensitivity to stimulus magnitude (b≈2.3) and a modest leftward intercept (a≈‑0.46). Accuracy is already high, but to evaluate unbiased performance before certification we should present a balanced mix of LEFT and RIGHT items with no side‑specific bonus.

Current logistic fit (a≈-1.4, b≈7.2) captures the steep psychometric function observed across blocks 7‑11. Performance is already well above the 0.78 threshold, so we keep the training conditions unchanged for block 12 to maintain stability before certification.
